text: The wolf, Canis lupus, lives in North America. Wolves may have a grey or a black coat colour. The
colour of an individual wolf depends on the DNA it inherits at the CPD103 gene locus.
• Wolves inherit two copies of CPD103, one from each parent.
• Wolves that inherit one copy of the black form of the CPD103 gene have a black coat.
